features.note: A renovated pool used for the aquatics program.
Frontage on the Nanticoke River and Marshyhope Creek.
Offered in the camp's Metal Arts program alongside welding.
Dining flies or pavilions at the campsites.
Canvas tents on full platforms in every campsite.
Electrical outlets at the tents in many campsites.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/081-HSRSummer); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
